title: The Akshayapatra
notes: Ep 04 rewrite 2026-10-01 (Ep 14 standard). Cause→effect: Sūrya’s vessel (rule: inexhaustible until Draupadi eats) → Duryodhana’s boon to Durvasa (visit after she has eaten) → Durvasa + ten thousand disciples arrive, go to bathe → Draupadi prays → Krishna hungry, eats the particle on the rim → sages sated in the river flee → trap closes on nothing. Comic mythology Amar Chitra — never photoreal. Draupadi deep red-rose sari, exile-simple gold. Krishna = Ep 09 lock. Durvasa fierce but stylized. Duryodhana = Ep 08 court lock (copied to stills/_locks/duryodhana.jpg). Locks are SuperGrok 1728×1152 (afd2ac4). Prop: akshayapatra bowl lock stills/_locks/akshayapatra.jpg — burnished copper-gold (text: copper).

draupadi.face: Young woman, warm brown skin, large dark eyes, soft brows, small bindi, calm dignity — painted comic, not photoreal
draupadi.hair: Long black wavy hair, simple gold ornaments — no peacock
draupadi.costume: Deep red or forest-rose sari with gold border, modest exile jewelry

krishna.face: Youthful divine smile, dark eyes, serene playfulness — same face as Ep 09
krishna.costume: Yellow pitambar dhoti, flower garland — charming comic, not photoreal CGI blue

tokens: hungry on arrival, sated and uneasy in the river
durvasa.face: Fierce ascetic sage, intense eyes, lean face, grey-white beard — comic mythology, not photoreal horror

yudhishthira.face: Gentle eldest Pandava, light mustache, composed — comic mythology

tokens: ten thousand (shown as a long file)
hungry on arrival, sated in the river
disciples.face: Background comic ascetic students — not photoreal portraits
disciples.costume: Saffron or cream bark-cloth, equal natural human scale

duryodhana.face: Adult Kaurava heir, proud dark mustache, fierce calculating gaze — same face as Ep 08/13 lock
duryodhana.hair: Dark hair under a jeweled Kuru crown / gold-trimmed royal turban-crown
duryodhana.costume: Purple-and-gold royal robes, gold jewelry (court dress of Hastinapura during the exile years) — no battle armor, no mace raised
